name: Santa Clara Recreation Leader I (as-needed, ages 16+)
org: City of Santa Clara Parks & Recreation
what_you_do: Lead games, sports, crafts and drama for kids at city parks and centers, and help at events like the Halloween Party and Art and Wine Festival. Recreation Leader I is the entry job made for high school students.
who_can_apply: Recreation Leader I: at least 16 when you apply and done with 10th grade (or the same level). No experience needed. Recreation Leader II and III need you to be 18 or older.
pay_detail: Recreation Leader I: $18.70 to $21.56 per hour. (Leader II: $19.28 to $25.10. Leader III: $20.65 to $27.57.)
duration: As-needed, part-time, up to 999 hours a year.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the City of Santa Clara job board (governmentjobs.com). Top applicants are invited to test or interview. A department interview is required before you are hired.
notes: The posting says a California work permit is needed at hire if you are under 18 and have not finished high school. You will be fingerprinted. This is an as-needed job, so hours are not promised.
